meta.name: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
aliases: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization!
meta.description:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.
High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

videos.title: Even High School Boys Have Their Holes… / Ume Takes Responsibility
videos.overview: Ume Mizunoe joins the student council so he doesn't have to repeat a year, but everyone there has such unique personalities. He nervously starts working there and gets thrown around by the council's strong personalities!

videos.title: Savior Tan / The Seven Mysteries of the Academy and the Council’s Night Patrol / Komaro Is Here!
videos.overview: Ume drops by the student council room as he takes care of something early in the morning. He then finds a young girl covered in blood slumped over a desk! And it seems the girl has become quite attached to Ume!?

videos.title: Pool Cleaning and the Swimsuit Episode / I’m Happy for You
videos.overview: When Ume gets home, he finds a suspicious figure—who turns out to be none other than his sister, Sho Mizunoe! Sho, Arisu, and Komaro engage in a who-knows-Ume-more one-upping battle. What's going on here!?

videos.title: Komaro and Her Suggestion Box / Terui-senpai’s Secret / Koki-chan and the Light Music Club / Rendezvous in the Gym Storage Room!!
videos.overview: The student council receives a complaint from the British tea ceremony club that the nearby music club is too noisy. It's not the instruments causing the noise, but something a bit more sensual!?

videos.title: The Student Council’s Bonding Retreat!! / Operation Ume Tan-Tan! / Ume Shares His Umbrella
videos.overview: Ume and Tan sneak around to study Arisu, whose true nature remains a bit of a mystery. When they see an opening and rummage through Arisu's things, she suddenly comes back out of nowhere! What are they going to do now!?

videos.title: Lost in the Moment / Ume and Hiratsuka-sensei / A Day in Komaro’s Life
videos.overview: As a thank-you for their help, the student council joins the British tea ceremony club for one of their activities. Hisako finishes up in the restroom, and she tries to go back to her seat but is unable to open the toilet stall door!?

videos.title: Komaro’s Challenge
videos.overview: There's a comment in the suggestion box! After seeing the suggestion, Komaro suggests selling affordable rice balls for the students. The student council moves to fulfill Komaro's and the students' wishes!
